description.zh:
订阅启动时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为秒（s）。
> Unix时间戳转换工具可用搜索引擎获取。
description.en:
The start time of change tracking, in the format of a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> You can use a search engine to find a UNIX timestamp converter.

description.zh: 订阅对象，格式为JSON串。详细定义，请参见[迁移、同步或订阅对象说明](~~209545~~)。
description.en: The objects to be tracked, in JSON format. For more information, see [Objects of DTS tasks](~~209545~~).

description.zh: DTS专属集群ID，用于将订阅任务调度到指定的DTS专属集群上。
description.en: The ID of the DTS dedicated cluster. This parameter is used to schedule the change tracking task to the specified DTS dedicated cluster.

description.zh:
是否监控延迟状态，取值：

- **true**：是。
- **false**：否。
description.en:
Specifies whether to monitor the latency status. Valid values:

- **true**: monitors the latency status.
- **false**: does not monitor the latency status.

description.zh:
延迟报警的联系人手机号码，多个手机号码以英文逗号（,）分隔。
>-  本参数目前只支持中国站，仅支持大陆手机号码，且最多传入10个手机号码。
- 国际站不支持手机告警，仅支持[通过云监控平台为DTS任务设置报警规则](~~175876~~)。
description.en:
The mobile phone numbers for receiving latency alerts. Separate multiple phone numbers with commas (,).
> - This parameter is supported only on the China site (aliyun.com). Only Chinese mainland phone numbers are supported, and you can specify up to 10 phone numbers.
- The China site (Chinese mainland) does not support phone alerts. You can only [configure alert rules for DTS tasks in CloudMonitor](~~175876~~).

description.zh:
触发延迟报警的阈值，单位为秒且需为整数，可根据业务需要设置阈值，建议设置10秒以上，避免因网络、数据库负载等原因导致的延迟波动。
> 当**DelayNotice**取值为**true**时，本参数必须传入。
description.en:
The threshold for triggering latency alerts. Unit: seconds. The value must be an integer. Set the threshold based on your business requirements. To avoid alert fluctuations caused by network conditions or database loads, set the threshold to 10 seconds or more.
> This parameter is required when **DelayNotice** is set to **true**.

description.zh:
DTS实例的环境标签，取值为：

- **normal**：**普通**
- **online**：**线上**
description.en:
The environment tag of the DTS instance. Valid values:

- **normal**: normal
- **online**: online.

description.zh: 订阅实例ID，可以调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)查询。
description.en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the instance ID.

description.zh: 订阅任务ID，可以调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)查询。
description.en: The ID of the change tracking task. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the task ID.

description.zh:
订阅任务名称。
> 建议配置具有业务意义的名称（无唯一性要求），便于后续识别。
description.en:
The name of the change tracking task.
> Specify a descriptive name that makes it easy to identify the task. The name does not need to be unique.

description.zh:
是否监控异常状态，取值：

- **true**：是。
- **false**：否。
description.en:
Specifies whether to monitor the error status. Valid values:

- **true**: monitors the error status.
- **false**: does not monitor the error status.

description.zh:
异常报警的联系人手机号码，多个手机号码以英文逗号（,）分隔。
>-  本参数目前只支持中国站，仅支持大陆手机号码，且最多传入10个手机号码。
- 国际站不支持手机告警，仅支持[通过云监控平台为DTS任务设置报警规则](~~175876~~)。
description.en:
The mobile phone numbers for receiving error alerts. Separate multiple phone numbers with commas (,).
> - This parameter is supported only on the China site (aliyun.com). Only Chinese mainland phone numbers are supported, and you can specify up to 10 phone numbers.
- The China site (Chinese mainland) does not support phone alerts. You can only [configure alert rules for DTS tasks in CloudMonitor](~~175876~~).

description.zh:
Serverless实例的DU上限，取值为：2、4、8、16。
<props="intl">
> 当前暂不支持此功能，请勿传入参数。</props>
description.en:
The maximum number of DUs for a serverless instance. Valid values: 2, 4, 8, and 16.
<props="intl">
> This feature is currently not supported. Do not specify this parameter.</props>.

description.zh:
Serverless实例的DU下限，取值为：1、2、4、8、16。
<props="intl">
> 当前暂不支持此功能，请勿传入参数。</props>
description.en:
The minimum number of DTS Units (DUs) for a serverless instance. Valid values: 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16.
<props="intl">
> This feature is currently not supported. Do not specify this parameter.</props>.

description.zh: 订阅实例所在地域，请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region in which the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh: DTS预留参数，格式为JSON串，您可以传入本参数完善源目库信息（如目标Kafka数据库的数据存储格式、云企业网CEN的实例ID）。更多信息，请参见[Reserve参数说明](~~176470~~)参数说明。
description.en: The reserved parameter of DTS, in JSON format. You can specify this parameter to add information about the source and destination databases, such as the data storage format of the destination Kafka database or the CEN instance ID. For more information, see the [Reserve metric description](~~176470~~).

description.zh: 资源组ID。
description.en: The resource group ID.

description.zh: 待订阅的数据库名称。
description.en: The name of the database to be tracked.

description.zh:
源数据库类型，取值为**MySQL**、**PostgreSQL**、**Oracle**。

> 当源数据库为自建数据库，本参数必须传入。
description.en:
The engine type of the source database. Valid values: **MySQL**, **PostgreSQL**, and **Oracle**.

> This parameter is required if the source database is a self-managed database.

description.zh:
源数据库的连接地址。
> 当源数据库为自建数据库时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
description.en:
The endpoint of the source database.
> This parameter is available and required only when the source database is a self-managed database.

description.zh:
源实例ID。
> 源数据库的实例类型为RDS MySQL、PolarDB-X 1.0、PolarDB MySQL时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
description.en:
The instance ID of the source instance.
> This parameter is active and required only when the source database is an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance, a PolarDB-X 1.0 instance, or a PolarDB for MySQL cluster.

description.zh:
源数据库的实例类型，取值：

- **RDS**：云数据库RDS。
- **PolarDB**：PolarDB MySQL。
-  **DRDS**: PolarDB-X 1.0。
- **LocalInstance**：有公网IP的自建数据库。
- **ECS**：ECS上的自建数据库。
- **Express**：通过专线接入的自建数据库。
- **CEN**：通过云企业网CEN接入的自建数据库。
- **dg**：通过数据库网关接入的自建数据库。
description.en:
The instance type of the source database. Valid values:

- **RDS**: ApsaraDB RDS instance.
- **PolarDB**: PolarDB for MySQL cluster.
- **DRDS**: PolarDB-X 1.0 instance.
- **LocalInstance**: self-managed database with a public IP address.
- **ECS**: self-managed database hosted on an ECS instance.
- **Express**: self-managed database connected over Express Connect.
- **CEN**: self-managed database connected over Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN).
- **dg**: self-managed database connected over Database Gateway.

description.zh:
Oracle数据库的SID信息。
> 当源数据库为自建Oracle时，且Oracle数据库为非RAC实例时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
description.en:
The SID of the Oracle database.
> This parameter is available and required only when the source database is a self-managed Oracle database that is not a Real Application Cluster (RAC) instance.

description.zh:
源实例所属的阿里云账号ID。
> 仅在配置跨阿里云账号的数据订阅时本参数才可用，且必须传入。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the account to which the source instance belongs.
> This parameter is active and required only when you configure cross-Alibaba Cloud account change tracking. You must subscribe to the task.

description.zh: 源实例的数据库账号密码。
description.en: The password of the database account for the source instance.

description.zh:
源数据库的服务端口。
> 当源数据库为自建数据库时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
description.en:
The service port of the source database.
> This parameter is available and required only when the source database is a self-managed database.

description.zh:
源实例所属地域，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
> 如果源实例为有公网IP的自建数据库，则可以传入**cn-hangzhou**或者离自建数据库物理距离最近的区域ID。
description.en:
The region of the source instance. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).
> If the source instance is a self-managed database with a public IP address, you can set this parameter to **cn-hangzhou** or the region ID closest to the self-managed database.

description.zh:
源实例的授权角色。当源实例与配置订阅任务所属阿里云账号不同时，需传入该参数，来指定源实例的授权角色，以允许配置订阅任务所属阿里云账号访问源实例的实例信息。
> 角色所需的权限及授权方式，请参见[跨阿里云账号数据迁移或同步时如何配置RAM授权](~~48468~~)。
description.en:
The authorized role of the source instance. If the source instance and the change tracking task belong to different Alibaba Cloud accounts, specify this parameter to allow the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the change tracking task to access the source instance.
> For more information about the permissions and authorization methods required for the role, see [Configure RAM authorization for cross-account data migration or synchronization](~~48468~~).

description.zh:
源实例的数据库账号。
> 订阅不同的数据库所需的权限有所差异，请参见[准备用于数据订阅的数据库账号](~~212653~~)中的账号权限。
description.en:
The database account of the source instance.
> The permissions required for change tracking vary depending on the database type. For more information, see the account permissions section in [Prepare database accounts for change tracking](~~212653~~).

description.zh:
源库通过SSL安全连接时，CA证书的路径。

> 当前暂不支持此功能，请勿传入此参数。
description.en:
The path of the CA certificate when the source database uses an SSL connection.

> This feature is currently not supported. Do not specify this parameter.

description.zh:
源库通过SSL安全连接时，CA证书的密钥。

> 当前暂不支持此功能，请勿传入此参数。
description.en:
The key of the CA certificate when the source database uses an SSL connection.

> This feature is currently not supported. Do not specify this parameter.

description.zh:
源库通过SSL安全连接时，客户端证书的路径。

> 当前暂不支持此功能，请勿传入此参数。
description.en:
The path of the client certificate when the source database uses an SSL connection.

> This feature is currently not supported. Do not specify this parameter.

description.zh:
源库通过SSL安全连接时，客户端证书私钥的路径。

> 当前暂不支持此功能，请勿传入此参数。
description.en:
The path of the client certificate private key when the source database uses an SSL connection.

> This feature is currently not supported. Do not specify this parameter.

description.zh:
源库通过SSL安全连接时，客户端证书私钥的密码。

> 当前暂不支持此功能，请勿传入此参数。
description.en:
The password of the client certificate private key when the source database uses an SSL connection.

> This feature is currently not supported. Do not specify this parameter.

description.zh:
是否订阅DDL类型的数据，取值：

- **true**：是，为默认值。
- **false**：否。
description.en:
Specifies whether to track DDL data. Valid values:

- **true** (default): tracks DDL data.
- **false**: does not track DDL data.

description.zh:
是否订阅DML类型的数据，取值：
- **true**：是，为默认值。
- **false**：否。
description.en:
Specifies whether to track DML data. Valid values:
- **true** (default): tracks DML data.
- **false**: does not track DML data.

description.zh:
订阅任务的网络类型，目前取值仅支持**vpc**，表示专有网络。

> - 如果传入了本参数，则订阅任务被定义为新版，您还需要正确设置**SubscriptionInstanceVPCId**和**SubscriptionInstanceVSwitchID**参数；如果不传入该参数，则订阅任务被定义为旧版。
- 旧版订阅任务支持订阅自建MySQL、RDS MySQL和PolarDB-X 1.0的数据，新版订阅任务支持订阅自建MySQL、RDS MySQL、PolarDB MySQL和Oracle的数据。
description.en:
The network type of the change tracking task. The only valid value is **vpc**, which indicates virtual private cloud (VPC).

> - If you specify this parameter, the change tracking task is defined as the new version. You must also correctly set the **SubscriptionInstanceVPCId** and **SubscriptionInstanceVSwitchID** parameters. If you do not specify this parameter, the change tracking task is defined as the legacy version.
- Legacy change tracking tasks support tracking data from self-managed MySQL, ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL, and PolarDB-X 1.0. New-version change tracking tasks support tracking data from self-managed MySQL, ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL, PolarDB for MySQL, and Oracle.

description.zh:
订阅实例的专有网络ID。
> 当**SubscriptionInstanceNetworkType**取值为**vpc**时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
description.en:
The VPC ID of the change tracking instance.
> This parameter is available and required only when **SubscriptionInstanceNetworkType** is set to **vpc**.

description.zh:
订阅实例的虚拟交换机ID。
> 当**SubscriptionInstanceNetworkType**取值为**vpc**时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
description.en:
The vSwitch ID of the change tracking instance.
> This parameter is available and required only when **SubscriptionInstanceNetworkType** is set to **vpc**.

title.en: Configure a DTS change tracking task

descriptions.zh: > 您可以根据需求在控制台进行相应的预配置，然后预览对应配置的OpenAPI参数信息，以协助您填写请求参数。更多信息，请参见[预览OpenAPI的请求参数](~~2851612~~)。
descriptions.en: > You can perform the required pre-configurations in the console and then preview the corresponding OpenAPI parameter information to help you specify request parameters. For more information, see [Preview OpenAPI request parameters](~~2851612~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts configure-subscription --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dts-job-name 'MySQL订阅' --dts-instance-id dtsy0zz3t13h7d0000 --dts-job-id y0zz3t13h7d0000 --source-endpoint-engine-name PostgreSQL --source-endpoint-instance-type RDS --source-endpoint-region cn-hangzhou --source-endpoint-instance-id rm-bp1zc3iyqe3qw0000 --source-endpoint-ip 172.16.80.000 --source-endpoint-port 3306 --source-endpoint-oracle-sid testsid --source-endpoint-database-name dtstestdata --source-endpoint-user-name dtstest --source-endpoint-password Test123456 --source-endpoint-owner-id 1406926474060000 --source-endpoint-role ram-for-dts --db-list dtstest_:_name_:_dtstest_,_all_:true --reserve srcInstanceId_:_cen-9kqshqum0000000 --checkpoint 1616902385 --subscription-instance-network-type vpc --subscription-instance-vpc-id vpc-bp1vwnn14rqpyiczj0000 --subscription-instance-vswitch-id vsw-bp10df3mxae6lpmku0000 --subscription-data-type-ddl true --subscription-data-type-dml true --delay-phone 13612340000,13712340000 --delay-rule-time 10 --delay-notice true --error-phone 13612340000,13712340000 --error-notice true --dedicated-cluster-id dtscluster_atyl3b5214uk000 --dts-bis-label normal --min-du 1.0 --max-du 16.0 --src-ca-certificate-oss-url 0000 --src-ca-certificate-password 0000 --src-client-cert-oss-url 0000 --src-client-key-oss-url 0000 --src-client-password 0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts ConfigureSubscription --region cn-hangzhou --Reserve 'srcInstanceId_:_cen-9kqshqum0000000' --DelayPhone '13612340000,13712340000' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --ErrorNotice true --DtsJobName 'MySQL订阅' --SourceEndpointInstanceID 'rm-bp1zc3iyqe3qw0000' --SourceEndpointDatabaseName dtstestdata --DelayRuleTime 10 --MinDu '1.0' --SourceEndpointIP '172.16.80.000' --SourceEndpointPort 3306 --DbList 'dtstest_:_name_:_dtstest_,_all_:true' --SubscriptionDataTypeDDL true --SourceEndpointRegion 'cn-hangzhou' --SubscriptionInstanceVPCId 'vpc-bp1vwnn14rqpyiczj0000' --DtsJobId y0zz3t13h7d0000 --SubscriptionInstanceVSwitchId 'vsw-bp10df3mxae6lpmku0000' --ErrorPhone '13612340000,13712340000' --SourceEndpointInstanceType RDS --SrcCaCertificatePassword 0000 --SourceEndpointUserName dtstest --MaxDu '16.0' --SrcClientCertOssUrl 0000 --SourceEndpointPassword Test123456 --DedicatedClusterId dtscluster_atyl3b5214uk000 --SourceEndpointRole 'ram-for-dts' --SourceEndpointEngineName PostgreSQL --SrcClientPassword 0000 --DtsInstanceId dtsy0zz3t13h7d0000 --DtsBisLabel normal --Checkpoint 1616902385 --DelayNotice true --SrcCaCertificateOssUrl 0000 --SrcClientKeyOssUrl 0000 --SubscriptionDataTypeDML true --SourceEndpointOracleSID testsid --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SourceEndpointOwnerID 1406926474060000 --SubscriptionInstanceNetworkType vpc
